compute.full_scale_declared: illustrative protocol stress shape: 16 GPUs, 1800 GPU-hours; not executed, measured, or sourced as a RIFT requirement

storage.full_scale_declared: illustrative protocol stress shape: 6 TB scratch, 30 TB retained products; not provisioned, measured, or sourced as a RIFT requirement
storage.downselect_declared: less than 1 MB inputs and artifacts

platform.full_scale_declared: illustrative HTCondor plus CUDA-capable workers; public RIFT documentation describes HTCondor and recommends CUDA/CuPy, but this fixture does not measure or execute them
platform.downselect: contemporary Python 3, no scheduler or accelerator

wall_clock.full_scale_declared: illustrative multi-day queue and execution latency; not measured or sourced as a RIFT requirement

operator_support.full_scale: scheduler, storage, failed-job recovery, and export review

monetary_allocative_cost.full_scale_declared: allocation required; monetary equivalent not asserted
monetary_allocative_cost.downselect: unmeasured; no separately allocated charge is claimed

freshness.on_failure: append stale or reproduction-failed event; do not overwrite prior evidence

non_substitutability: The ten axes are descriptive and not reducible to a scalar; expert judgment, restricted access, storage, and GPU-hours are not interchangeable.
